questions.q: Which liberator led Colombia's fight for independence from Spain?
questions.why: He was the first President of Gran Colombia.

questions.q: In which year did Colombia declare independence?
questions.why: 20 July is Independence Day.

questions.q: Which 1819 battle secured Colombia's independence?
questions.why: It is remembered on 7 August.

questions.q: Which Colombian author won the 1982 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: He wrote 'One Hundred Years of Solitude'.

questions.q: What was the union of Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador and Panama called?
questions.why: It broke apart in 1831.

questions.q: What was the Spanish colony covering Colombia called?
questions.why: Its viceroy sat in Bogotá.

questions.q: Which President won the 2016 Nobel Peace Prize for a deal with the FARC?
questions.why: The deal ended over 50 years of conflict.

questions.q: Which country separated from Colombia in 1903?
questions.why: The US then built the Panama Canal.

questions.q: Which legendary city of gold did Spaniards hunt for in Colombia?
questions.why: The legend began with a Muisca ritual at Lake Guatavita.

questions.q: Which period of violence began in 1948 after the murder of Jorge Gaitán?
questions.why: It lasted about ten years.

questions.q: Which Indigenous people lived in the highlands around Bogotá?
questions.why: They were skilled goldsmiths.

questions.q: Who became Colombia's first left-wing President, in 2022?
questions.why: His Vice President is Francia Márquez.

questions.q: Which walled Caribbean city is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: Its walls protected Spanish treasure fleets.

questions.q: Which ancient 'Lost City' in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta was found in 1972?
questions.why: It is older than Machu Picchu.

questions.q: Who was the 'Man of Laws', Bolívar's vice-president?
questions.why: He later became President of New Granada.

questions.q: What is the capital of Colombia?
questions.why: It sits at about 2,640 m.

questions.q: Which crop is Colombia world-famous for?
questions.why: The Coffee Cultural Landscape is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which Colombian singer had hits with 'Hips Don't Lie' and 'Waka Waka'?
questions.why: She is from Barranquilla.

questions.q: Which dance music from Colombia's Caribbean coast spread across Latin America?
questions.why: It mixes African, Indigenous and Spanish roots.

questions.q: Which city is called the 'City of Eternal Spring'?
questions.why: Its mild climate lasts all year.

questions.q: What is Colombia's currency?
questions.why: Its code is COP.

questions.q: Which two seas or oceans does Colombia have coasts on?
questions.why: It is the only South American country with both.

questions.q: Which city is called the world's salsa capital?
questions.why: It holds a huge salsa festival.

questions.q: Which river is called the 'river of five colours'?
questions.why: Water plants turn it red, yellow and green.

questions.q: Which Colombian carnival is on UNESCO's heritage list?
questions.why: It is one of Latin America's biggest.

questions.q: Which corn cakes are a Colombian staple?
questions.why: They are eaten at breakfast and beyond.

questions.q: Which is Colombia's main river?
questions.why: It runs north to the Caribbean.

questions.q: Which Colombian artist painted and sculpted plump, rounded figures?
questions.why: Medellín has a plaza of his sculptures.

questions.q: Which underground cathedral was carved into a salt mine near Bogotá?
questions.why: It holds services deep below ground.

questions.q: Which Bogotá soup is made with chicken, corn and three kinds of potato?
questions.why: It is flavoured with the herb guasca.
